status: EXPERIMENTAL. A ledger of track claims, not new claims.
selection: Every VERIFIED or SUPPORTED finding in A, B, C, E, G whose being wrong would change an ADR, a recommendation, a security posture statement or a candidate public statement. Lower-consequence VERIFIED/SUPPORTED findings are listed under 'omittedLowConsequence'.

claims.title: Rehearsal 8 token total reproduces exactly from raw execution records
claims.consequenceIfWrong: Every cost figure in the sprint and any external cost claim inherits this total.
claims.trackLimitations: 8 R8 executions (coordinator-run CRs, infra) have no transcript; coordinator turns after 23:50:44Z missing. No provider bill exists.

discrepancies: Track A data README says R8 requestLedger covers 49 executions; I find 48 ledgers (48 records with token data) and 3,100 requests. Totals unaffected.

$193.74 depends on pricing cache writes by their 5m/1h split (almost all R8 cache writes are 1h); a 5m-only basis gives $190.51. R3 had no split, so the 'same method' reproduces R3 only under the 5m fallback, which is what Track A states.

claims.title: Coordinator is 44% of R8 tokens and 32% of cost, driven by context size
claims.consequenceIfWrong: Coordinator-context ADR (ADR-S05) and the largest estimated saving rest on it.
claims.trackLimitations: Single rehearsal; coordinator session began 10 min before T0.

claims.title: Cache reads are 98% of tokens but 54% of cost; output is 22% of cost
claims.consequenceIfWrong: Caching strategy and cost-structure statements would be wrong.
claims.trackLimitations: List prices, not billed rates.

11 PRs logged conflict:false had branch-side conflicts (mostly .ros).

claims.title: R8 used on average 2.15 of 6 lanes
claims.consequenceIfWrong: Dispatch/parallelism investment decisions.

discrepancies: 350 samples end at 23:21:24Z, not at merge freeze (23:50:28Z, T+379); the label is wrong and the full window gives 2.01 / 33.6%.
Peak 5 is concurrent agents; two agents shared a lane at the peak (peak distinct lanes = 4). 'Lane utilisation' of 6 lanes is therefore at most 4 at peak.
Transcript spans include pre-'work start' time (e.g. T18 agent span begins 10 min before its Praxis work start); Praxis spans give 1.57.
